state.question: An icon-only toolbar button needs the label Download report on mouse hover or keyboard focus. What should be used? Choose the best answer A Open a card with format choices and a confirmation button B Explain the icon in a message only after download is clicked C Attach a text tooltip that opens on both hover and focus This judgment fits A short label explains the icon, and supporting both mouse and keyboard makes the hint reachable. Next question Question 1 Practice area All areas (328) Tooltip Tooltip You might say When someone hovers over this icon, show a short label explaining what it does. Explain a compact control with a short text label·A tooltip gives a brief label or hint for an icon or unfamiliar control. It should appear on keyboard focus as well as hover and must not contain essential instructions. If the content is longer or interactive, use a Popover. Know first Button ⚙ Settings ★ Collection ⬇ Download You can say this to an AI Agent “ Add a Download report tooltip to the icon, opening on hover and keyboard focus and closing on leave or blur. Keep format choices and errors outside it, and verify the action remains understandable on touch. When to use it Label an icon-only button Settings ⚙ ★ ⬇ Expand an abbreviated term 2026-product-plan-final-v3-final.sketch 2026-product-plan-final-v3… Give a short hint for an unfamiliar control Margin uses EBITDA: earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization EBITDA as its basis. Show the full value of truncated text Tasks Calendar days from creation to delivery Cycle time ⓘ Sign-in page 6 days When NOT to use it Hide required instructions inside a tooltip ⚙ There is no hover on mobile, so this hint never appears. Put links or forms inside it Notification settings Manage preferences → 🔔 Repeat a label that is already visible Hint ⚙ Hint ★ Hint ⬇ Hint ✎ Hint ☰ Support hover only and ignore keyboard or touch Email Required The required rule is hidden in a tooltip until submit fails. Anatomy Copy link ⧉ 1 Bubble Small dark strips containing only plain text 2 Arrow Points to the triggering element, indicating which element the prompt is associated with 3 Trigger Supports hover, keyboard focus or touch screen operation triggering Variants Top Settings ⚙ Default orientation, use it first if there is space above Bottom ★ Collection When elements are close to the top of the page, they are displayed downwards first. Left Download ⬇ The element is close to the right edge, so the bubble is placed to the left so that it will not be clipped. Right ✎ Edit The element is closer to the left edge, so the bubble is placed to the right so that it will not be clipped. Typical use cases Toolbar icon Save to cloud ✎ ⬆ ⬇ ⋯ Abbreviation 2026-Summer Marketing Plan-final-v3.pptx 📄 2026-Summer Marketing Plan-fin… Truncated filename Total transaction volume: the sum of all order amounts within the statistical period This quarter GMV The year-on-year growth was 32%, mainly contributed by new products. Chart label Conversion rate = number of orders placed ÷ number of visitors, calculated on a daily basis Date Visits Conversion rate ⓘ QUICK DECISION Tooltip vs Popover: which one should you use? Use a Tooltip for a short, read-only explanation. Use a Popover for longer information or controls people need to interact with. Decision point Tooltip Popover Content scope One short label or hint. Longer information, links, buttons, or form controls. Interactivity Read-only and available on keyboard focus as well as hover. Can remain open while someone clicks or types inside it. Best fit Explaining an icon button, truncated title, or abbreviation. Showing contextual details, a small set of options, or a compact form. Configuring a file export button If a download icon only needs to display the text “Download report” on hover or focus, choose a Tooltip. If clicking the icon lets users choose between PDF and CSV before initiating the export, use a Popover so they can interact with the options.
